description: This Java source file defines a utility class for processing command-line arguments for the OFBiz framework. It manages options such as start, stop, load data, and testing, utilizing Apache Commons CLI for parsing. The class provides methods to parse commands, print help messages, and validate inputs, thus supporting the command-line interface of OFBiz's startup process.

classes.name: StartupCommandUtil
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for parsing and handling OFBiz command-line options, as well as defining command options.

methods.name: parseOfbizCommands
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into a list of StartupCommand objects, throwing StartupException on errors.

methods.name: printOfbizStartupHelp
methods.description: Prints the command-line help message for OFBiz startup options.

methods.name: highlightAndPrintErrorMessage
methods.description: Outputs an error message highlighted with separator lines to standard error.
